title: ID0419122-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P6 170000689] CCS connector issue
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: There is a problem on the CCS cable of this charger (CCS1, cable at the left of the charger). Indeed, we can see that the DC- and DC+ pin blades are very dirty which can cause overheating problems. I tried to clean them but the dirt is incrusted. Can you plan an intervention with the french team please to change the CCS connector.
Solution: N/A
yyyy-mm-dd: 2025-04-15
